summary: Completed comprehensive testing of X Autopilot module (FASE X). All backend endpoints and frontend UI components working correctly in MOCK mode with zero real X API calls.

Backend: GET status returns queue with total>=1, order list, skip categories (skipped_no_public_media, skipped_no_secret_media, skipped_no_of_link, not_x_safe)
Backend: GET status returns schedule.next_slot.slot_id starting with 'x_' and ending with 12:30/18:30/22:00
